zh: 长文档字号和编号预检期间可以继续输入并更新公式预览，精简文档快照和预览缓存。修复 Word 会话偶尔提前结束、成功打开后误报超时，以及后台定位更新后普通保存可能漏写的问题。保留不支持的旧字体编码及复杂编号段落的安全跳过规则。
en: Keeps formula input and previews responsive during long-document typography and numbering preflights, with smaller document snapshots and preview caches. Fixes premature Word session retirement, a false timeout after successful opening, and missed ordinary saves after a background target update. Unsupported legacy font encodings and complex numbering paragraphs remain safely skipped.
